"""FlowGuard fixture: Step10/step10_baublock_progress_maps.py lines 2174-2180 of KWP 64479aa, copied verbatim."""
import math


def _matlab_round_scalar(value: float) -> int:
    """Round a finite scalar with MATLAB's half-away-from-zero rule."""
    number = float(value)
    if not math.isfinite(number):
        raise ValueError("_matlab_round_scalar requires a finite scalar")
    return math.floor(number + 0.5) if number >= 0.0 else math.ceil(number - 0.5)
